name: Pip
source:
Affiliation: Unknown
Location: USF Agni
Relationship: Prisoner
Personnel File: Pip is a talented mercenary with a traumatic past. Valuing money and reputation over any other loyalties, she accepted jobs from anybody who paid on time. This may perhaps have led her into the path of an unplanned destiny.
Strengths: Stealth, Manipulation, Programming, Tech Adaptability, Hand to hand Combat, Charisma.
Weaknesses: Loner, Greedy, Poor impulse Control, Overconfident, Haunted by her Past.
Note inserted in file: Wanted for questioning by at least three council governments
